(M. Herzog, J. Schönheim). Let G be a group and let k ⩾ 2. Let H1 , . . . , Hk
be subgroups of G, and g1 , . . . , gk elements of G such that the cosets g1 H1 , . . . , gk Hk
form a partition of G. Is it true that |G : Hi | = |G : Hj | for some i ̸= j?
   This is known to be true for groups with a Sylow tower (M. A. Berger, A. Felzen-
baum, A. Fraenkel, Fund. Math., 128, no. 3 (1987), 139–144). Also cf. 20.99.
                                                                                  L. Margolis
